## Effort and likelihood

Every issue is scored when it is filed (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/oliverclaude/syncfs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)).
Lower is better on both axes. Please propose:

- **Effort** (1–5): 1 is the smallest or easiest fix, 5 is the largest or hardest.
- **Likelihood** (1–5): 1 is the most likely to happen, or to hit users or CI; 5 is rare.
- **Reason** (one line): why those scores.
